item.title: FBI arrests fake 49er accused of scamming women out of $1.3 million via dating apps
item.description: Daejon Love allegedly formed fake relationships with women before pressuring them to send him thousands of dollars for fake investments.

item.title: New Seahawks owner Vinod Khosla defends Steelers fandom amid criticism
item.description: Khosla said he began rooting for the Steelers after arriving in the U.S. in 1976 and remains a big fan of the team.
item.media:description: The Khosla family, including Neeru (left), Vinod (center) and Neal, were approved as the Seahawks' new owners on Wednesday.

item.title: The NFL finally put the Pro Bowl out of its misery. It was time
item.description: This is a surrender, a rare defeat for a sport that long ago surpassed Major League Baseball as the national pastime.
item.media:description: Recent NFL Pro Bowlers such as Jaymyr Gibbs, center, have played flag football instead of the sport they were honored for.
